faq.title: Questions shops ask
faq.lead: Can't find your answer? Message us on Telegram.

afterTrial.a: You move to the Free plan. Nothing is deleted, and you can subscribe at any time to switch everything back on.

phones.a: Yes. It runs in the browser on phones, tablets, and PCs, with nothing to install.

receipts.a: Yes, on 80 mm and 58 mm receipt printers, with totals in dollars and riel.

staffEmail.a: No. Invite them with a link on Telegram or a QR code. They set their own password.

manyBusinesses.q: Can I run more than one business?
manyBusinesses.a: Yes. One account can own several businesses, each with its own plan.

privacy.q: Can other shops see my data?
privacy.a: No. Each business's data is private to its own members.

rate.q: What exchange rate does it use?
rate.a: The rate you enter each day. Every sale keeps the rate it used, so old receipts never change.

offline.q: What if the internet is slow?
offline.a: Pages are light and lists load page by page, so it works on a 4G hotspot. The POS needs a connection to save a sale.

pay.q: How do I pay for a plan?
pay.a: In the app, under Settings › Billing. Prices are in USD, monthly or yearly.

cancel.a: Yes. Your plan stays active until the end of the period you paid for, then the business moves to the Free plan.

about.title: Built for the shops we grew up with
about.lead: ModernStock is a bachelor's thesis project. We want small shops in Cambodia to know their stock as well as big supermarkets do.
about.story1: Most mini-marts, pharmacies, and hardware shops in Cambodia still keep stock in notebooks or Excel. Owners find out too late that products ran out or expired, and mistakes in riel change add up every day.
about.story2: Foreign software rarely fits: it is not in Khmer, it doesn't round riel, and it expects every cashier to have an email. ModernStock starts from how Cambodian shops really work.
about.teamNote: Names, photos, and roles will be added by the team.
about.uniText: A bachelor's thesis in Computer Science. The university, faculty, and advisor will be added here.

legal.termsIntro: These terms explain the rules for using ModernStock. By creating an account, you accept them.
legal.termsAccount: Keep your password secret. You are responsible for what happens in your account and in the businesses you own.
legal.termsBusiness: The products, sales, customers, and other records you enter belong to your business. We use them only to run the service for you.
legal.termsPlans: Every new business gets 30 days of Pro. After that, it moves to the Free plan unless you subscribe. Prices are in USD and can change; a new price applies at your next renewal.
legal.termsEnd: Nothing is deleted. The business moves to the Free plan limits, and you can subscribe again at any time.
legal.termsUse: Don't use ModernStock for anything illegal, and don't try to access another business's data.
legal.termsContact: Questions about these terms: use the Contact page.
legal.privacyIntro: This policy explains which personal data ModernStock keeps and why.
legal.privacyCollect: Your name, email or username, phone number, and language; the business records you enter; and technical logs needed to keep the service safe.
legal.privacyUse: To run your account and businesses, send verification, invitation, and reset messages, and send the Telegram summaries you turn on. We don't sell your data.
legal.privacyShare: Only the members of your business, with the rights their role gives them. The platform team can see accounts and plans, but not your stock, sales, or customers.
legal.privacyKeep: As long as your account exists. Ask us through the Contact page to delete your account.
legal.privacyRights: You can change your profile and language at any time, and turn Telegram alerts off in the business settings.
